purpose: bounded native raw line/load orchestration with event-aware diagnostics
native_protocol: progress DECK WALL_SECONDS TARGET_SECONDS EXPORT_PATH SNAPSHOT_PATH; export is little-endian ngspice real native raw
pipeline: raw FIFO -> pigz raw.trace.raw.gz -> native decoder/audit -> decoder/normalizer/checker and decoder/normalizer/event-metrics
outputs: raw.trace.raw.gz plus bounded reports; no uncompressed TSV; per-case status complete_review_pending

tool_contracts.event_audit: stdin normal15 text; --end-s T --rload R --events OWNED_EVENTS_PATH

validation: full manifest before optional cases selection
10 GiB disk floor before and during pipeline
acceptance: none; checker, metrics, and audit outputs require parent review and never auto-promote a case
